The adopted clip passed as ONE uniform-spacing stride with NO substitutions: frames frame_0052 (contact, near fist crossed in front) / frame_0057 (passing) / frame_0062 (opposite contact, arm swung behind) / frame_0067 (opposite passing); measured a'+2.0/c'−5.4, pair IoUs ≤0.85, IoU(a,c)=0.62 — the approved boy's fingerprint (a'−2.6/c'+2.5, IoU(a,c)=0.69). Rejected en route (all recorded in docs/asset-factory.md): whole-sheet and per-frame nano reskins of the boy sheet (static models soften/duplicate leg poses — the ①a collapse), seedance-2.0 i2v (marching; camisole→cream swap that evades distance-based drift checks), seedance-2.0 reference-video motion transfer of the boy loop (r2v — one wide contact per period), mirror-cycle (lighting strobe), and 12+ takes whose failures the new gates catch mechanically. The head paste for walk-c is corrected −4px (96-space; −17px at the 400px compose scale) so the head sits above the torso like the other frames — rebuilt from the retained take clip (/tmp preserved per-take), no regeneration. Round-5 owner fix (もう2px頭を後ろに): walk-c head paste total correction −6px (96-space; −25px at compose scale). The extra shift uncovered the source frame's under-chin camisole shading (gray-blue) — briefly excused via an acknowledged-drift exemption, which the owner rejected on sight (目視では影がおかしい — the calibrated drift gate had been right).
